fees.notes: Needed to hunt those areas, not to apply.

prerequisites.text: No separate hunting license is required to apply. You need a WGFD online account (username and password); the full license fee plus the application fee is charged when you apply, and the license fee is credited back if you do not draw.
prerequisites.quote: All customers must have a username and password to make a purchase or apply for a license ... we will immediately charge your credit card for the full amount of the license plus the application fee

prerequisites.text: Hunter education is required to hunt with a firearm if born on or after January 1, 1966 (some exemptions). It is not required to apply.
prerequisites.quote: Hunter Education is required to hunt with a firearm in Wyoming if you were born on or after January 1, 1966.

prerequisites.text: Youth must be at least 11 when applying and 12 by Dec. 31 to earn or buy preference points.
prerequisites.quote: Youths can apply for preference points when they are 11 years old when submitting a preference point-only application and must be at least 12 by Dec. 31 of that year.

prerequisites.text: Full-price bighorn sheep and Type 1 moose are once in a lifetime; ewe/lamb sheep and Type 4 moose carry a 5-year wait.
prerequisites.quote: A full price bighorn sheep license is a once-in-a-life time license. A successful applicant of an ewe lamb bighorn sheep must wait five years before applying again.

notes: No 2027 application dates are posted yet (checked 2026-11-04): no 2027 application handbook is out and the agency dates page prints no year; its dates match the 2026 handbook, so all draws are recorded as 2026/last_year. Times: the 2026 handbook says applications open at 8:00 a.m. on the open date and must be submitted 'by midnight mountain time on the deadline date' - recorded here as 23:59 MT on that date. Results dates are listed by WGFD as tentative. Nonresident elk could modify/withdraw through May 8 (2026). The 2026 point-only window was July 1 - Nov. 2 per the 2026 handbook and dates page (a 2025 release gave Oct. 31 for 2025). The fee list page has no year printed; amounts are consistent with the 2026 handbook totals, so they are labeled 2026. A credit-card processing fee is added to every transaction (amount not stated). Mountain goat has no preference points. Wild bison, landowner licenses and the Super Tag raffle were left out (out of scope). Conservation stamp requirement details not verified.
